MCSE: sqrt(B/m) for pooled slope; not a standard error for the scientific target or an adequacy threshold
RSS_failure_floor: reject RSS <= 1e-24 * max(1,sum(y^2)); fail rather than treat a numerically exact line as a predictive model
analysis: OLS slope on each completed dataset; U=RSS_complete/(n-2) * inverse(Xfull^T Xfull)[1,1] (zero-based slope coordinate)
completion: copy every observed y exactly; independently draw missing y from xrow*beta + sqrt(sigma2)*z_residual; no clipping, rounding or donor substitution
conditioning: require design Gram determinant > 1e-12 times product of its diagonal entries; reject instead of regularizing
design: columns [1,x] in that order; rows sorted P001..P032; no centering/scaling/ridge added
df: nucom=n-2; nuold=(m-1)/lambda^2; nuobs=nucom*(nucom+1)/(nucom+3)*(1-lambda); nubr=1/(1/nuold+1/nuobs); no lambda floor; reject nubr<1
failures: nonfinite results or insufficient adjusted degrees of freedom
interval: Qbar +/- Student-t(.975,nubr)*sqrt(T); nominal model-based approximate 95% interval, no coverage demonstration
missingness_link: ignorable missing y conditional on x, with distinct missingness/model parameters; a teaching assumption, not established by this pattern
model: y = beta0 + beta1*x + iid Normal(0,sigma2); x fully observed, treated as fixed
no_missing: bypass random tape and MI; ordinary complete-data OLS and t interval at n-2 df; zero B/lambda/fmi/MCSE; do not pool identical artificial copies
output: 17 significant digits; every posterior parameter, all 20x32 completions, every Q/U and pooled quantity; exact observed-cell preservation
pooling: Rubin Qbar, W, B sample variance (m-1), T=W+(1+1/m)B; r=(1+1/m)B/W, lambda=(1+1/m)B/T
posterior: RSS_obs / sum(z_variance^2), df=nobs-2; beta=OLS_obs + sqrt(sigma2)*L*z_beta where L is the lower positive-diagonal Cholesky factor of inverse(Xobs^T Xobs)
support: unbounded continuous y; no Likert scores enter
target: population conditional normal-regression slope beta1 for a fictional continuous calibration response; not any Tonmick score or finite-roster target
zero_between: if B=0 and W>0: nuold serialized -1 (infinite), nubr=nuobs by limit; no lambda floor
